<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is obtained by killing [[Monsters|spiders]] in the [[dungeon]]. Its only known purpose is as a product of alchemy; once studied, it can be broken down into the Slowing variants of [[Slowing powder|powder]] and [[Slowing extract|extract]].

==Alchemy==
Spider web can be decomposed to [[slowing powder|powder]] and [[slowing extract|extract]] with the [[alchemy mill]] and either [[Distillation cube|distillation]] [[Distillation cube II|cube]], respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.
